sources.title: Architecture graph for barozp/Qwen3.8-27B-Opus-Distill.
sources.snippet: barozp/Qwen3.8-27B-Opus-Distill is an image-text-to-text model (qwen3_5_text architecture). It uses 64 transformer layers, a hidden size of 5,120, and 24 query heads with 4 key/value heads (grouped-query attention).

sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.
